title: Midimotor
description: MidiMotor is an instrument that controls other vsti's via midi routing inside the DAW and actually acts like a hardware midi controller. It's buttons and knobs can be learnt by knobs and buttons in other vsti's and get powered by them. BUT! there is also an interesting twist: All MidiMotor's knobs and buttons are motorized, so they can let the user run them in a loop from any minimum to maximum point (and backward) by using any midi CC, midi channel, speed or synced speed. That's why motorizing can create a vast of unique sounds and tones from any synth and enrich creativity and exclusiveness.
